text: Lengkapkan peribahasa ini: “Di mana bumi dipijak, di situ … dijunjung.”
gloss: Complete the proverb: 'Where the earth is trodden, there the … is upheld.' — Sky (langit): 'when in Rome, do as the Romans do'.

text: Perkataan manakah dibaca sama, sama ada dari kiri ke kanan atau dari kanan ke kiri?
gloss: Which word reads the same left-to-right and right-to-left? — Katak (frog): k-a-t-a-k is a palindrome; the others are not.

text: Pada waktu subuh suhu di sebuah bandar ialah −5 °C, dan pada tengah hari 15 °C. Berapa darjahkah suhu itu naik?
gloss: At dawn it is −5 °C, at noon 15 °C. By how many degrees did it rise? — 20: from −5 to 0 is 5, then 15 more. 10 traps those who just subtract the numbers.

text: Aminah tidur pada pukul 10 malam dan terjaga pada pukul 6 pagi keesokannya. Berapa lamakah dia tidur?
gloss: Aminah sleeps at 10 pm and wakes at 6 am. How long did she sleep? — 8 hours: 2 hours to midnight plus 6. 4 traps those who compute 10 − 6.

text: Selat manakah yang memisahkan Semenanjung Malaysia daripada Pulau Sumatera?
gloss: Which strait separates Peninsular Malaysia from Sumatra? — The Strait of Malacca. Sunda, Karimata and Lombok are all Indonesian straits elsewhere.

text: Nasi lemak mendapat nama dan rasa lemaknya daripada bahan apa yang dimasak bersama beras?
gloss: Nasi lemak gets its name and rich taste from what, cooked with the rice? — Coconut milk (santan).

text: Ikan paus perlu timbul ke permukaan laut dari semasa ke semasa untuk bernafas. Organ apakah yang digunakannya untuk bernafas?
gloss: Whales must surface from time to time to breathe. Which organ do they breathe with? — Lungs: whales are mammals, despite the Malay name 'ikan' (fish).

text: Datuk Lee Chong Wei memenangi tiga pingat perak Olimpik bagi Malaysia. Dalam sukan apa?
gloss: Lee Chong Wei won three Olympic silver medals for Malaysia. In which sport? — Badminton (men's singles, 2008, 2012, 2016).

text: Hari Raya Aidilfitri disambut sebaik sahaja umat Islam selesai berpuasa sebulan. Dalam bulan apakah mereka berpuasa?
gloss: Eid al-Fitr is celebrated once Muslims finish a month of fasting. In which month do they fast? — Ramadan. Syawal is the month Hari Raya itself falls on, a trap for the hasty.

text: Seorang pelukis mencampurkan cat biru dengan cat kuning di atas paletnya. Warna apakah yang terhasil?
gloss: A painter mixes blue and yellow paint. What colour results? — Green.

text: Hari ini hari Isnin. Jika kenduri diadakan pada hari tulat, hari apakah kenduri itu?
gloss: Today is Monday. If the feast is held on 'tulat', which day is it? — Thursday: esok is tomorrow, lusa the day after, tulat the day after lusa. Wednesday (lusa) is the trap.

text: Pada pagi 31 Ogos 1957, Tunku Abdul Rahman membaca pemasyhuran kemerdekaan Persekutuan Tanah Melayu di sebuah stadium. Stadium apakah itu?
gloss: On 31 August 1957 Tunku Abdul Rahman read the proclamation of independence in which stadium? — Stadium Merdeka, built for the occasion. Stadium Negara opened in 1962, Shah Alam and Bukit Jalil in the 1990s.

text: Anda berdiri tegak menghadap matahari yang sedang terbit. Arah utara berada di sebelah mana anda?
gloss: You stand facing the rising sun. On which side is north? — Left: the sun rises in the east, and facing east, north is on your left.

text: Rafflesia, antara bunga terbesar di dunia, tumbuh di hutan Sabah, Sarawak dan Semenanjung. Bunga ini terkenal kerana baunya. Bau apakah itu?
gloss: Rafflesia, among the world's biggest flowers, grows in Malaysian forests and is known for its smell. What smell? — Rotting meat: it attracts carrion flies as pollinators.

text: Dalam Hikayat Hang Tuah, sahabat manakah yang menderhaka kepada Sultan Melaka lalu bertikam dengan Hang Tuah sendiri?
gloss: In the Hikayat Hang Tuah, which friend rebelled against the Sultan and fought Hang Tuah himself? — Hang Jebat. Hang Kasturi is the trap: he is the rebel in the Sejarah Melayu version, hence 'in the Hikayat Hang Tuah'.

text: Komposer manakah terus mencipta karya agung, termasuk Simfoni Kesembilan, walaupun pendengarannya sudah hampir hilang sama sekali?
gloss: Which composer kept writing masterpieces, including the Ninth Symphony, while almost completely deaf? — Beethoven.

text: Trio filem “Bujang Lapok” terdiri daripada P. Ramlee, S. Shamsuddin dan seorang lagi pelakon. Siapakah dia?
gloss: The 'Bujang Lapok' trio was P. Ramlee, S. Shamsuddin and which other actor? — Aziz Sattar. Jins Shamsuddin is a name trap; Ibrahim Pendek and Salleh Kamil acted with P. Ramlee too.

text: Jalur Gemilang mempunyai 14 jalur merah dan putih yang berselang-seli. Berapakah jalur yang berwarna merah?
gloss: The Malaysian flag has 14 alternating red and white stripes. How many are red? — 7: an even number of alternating stripes splits evenly, whichever colour comes first.

text: Microsoft diasaskan pada tahun 1975 oleh dua sahabat sejak zaman persekolahan: Paul Allen dan siapa?
gloss: Microsoft was founded in 1975 by two school friends: Paul Allen and whom? — Bill Gates. Jobs and Wozniak founded Apple, Page co-founded Google.

text: Dalam siri animasi “Upin & Ipin”, siapakah yang membesarkan pasangan kembar itu bersama Opah?
gloss: In 'Upin & Ipin', who raises the twins together with their grandmother? — Kak Ros, their elder sister. Mei Mei and Susanti are friends, Cikgu Jasmin their teacher.

text: Kita memerlukan oksigen untuk hidup, tetapi gas itu bukanlah yang paling banyak dalam udara. Gas manakah yang paling banyak?
gloss: We need oxygen, but it is not the most plentiful gas in air. Which is? — Nitrogen, about 78%.

text: Perkataan “almari”, “bendera”, “jendela” dan “keju” dipinjam daripada bahasa yang sama. Bahasa apakah itu?
gloss: 'Almari', 'bendera', 'jendela' and 'keju' come from the same language. Which? — Portuguese: armário, bandeira, janela, queijo. Spanish tempts (bandera), but its 'ventana' and 'queso' don't fit.

text: Pada musim sejuk di England, jam di Kuala Lumpur menunjukkan pukul 12 tengah hari. Pukul berapakah ketika itu di London?
gloss: In the English winter it is noon in Kuala Lumpur. What time is it in London? — 4 am: Malaysia is UTC+8, London in winter UTC+0, and London is behind, not ahead.

text: Tulisan hieroglif Mesir purba dapat dibaca semula pada abad ke-19 berkat sebuah batu yang memuatkan teks yang sama dalam tiga tulisan. Batu apakah itu?
gloss: Egyptian hieroglyphs were deciphered in the 19th century thanks to a stone bearing one text in three scripts. Which? — The Rosetta Stone. The Behistun inscription played the same role for cuneiform.

text: Sebuah kejohanan badminton perseorangan menggunakan sistem kalah mati dengan 64 pemain. Berapa perlawanan perlu dimainkan untuk menentukan juara?
gloss: A knockout singles tournament has 64 players. How many matches decide the champion? — 63: every match eliminates exactly one player, and 63 must go. 6 is the number of rounds.

text: Untuk menolak pinangan Sultan Melaka, Puteri Gunung Ledang meminta antaranya jambatan emas dan perak, serta tujuh dulang hati seekor makhluk kecil. Makhluk apakah itu?
gloss: To refuse the Sultan of Malacca's proposal, the Princess of Mount Ledang asked, among other things, for a gold and silver bridge and seven trays of the livers of a tiny creature. Which? — Mosquitoes (hati nyamuk).

text: Don Quixote, kesatria khayalan yang menyerang kincir angin kerana menyangkanya raksasa, ialah ciptaan pengarang dari negara mana?
gloss: Don Quixote, the would-be knight who attacks windmills thinking they are giants, was created by a writer from which country? — Spain (Miguel de Cervantes).

text: Teh hijau dan teh hitam dibuat daripada daun pokok yang sama. Apakah yang menjadikan kedua-duanya berbeza?
gloss: Green and black tea come from the same plant. What makes them different? — How far the leaves are oxidised: black tea fully, green tea hardly at all (both are Camellia sinensis).

text: Komputer menyimpan nombor dalam sistem perduaan, yang hanya menggunakan digit 0 dan 1. Nombor perduaan 101 bersamaan dengan nombor apa dalam sistem biasa?
gloss: Binary 101 equals what decimal number? — 5: one 4, no 2, one 1.

text: Pengarah manakah membikin filem “E.T.”, tentang makhluk asing yang ingin pulang, dan “Jurassic Park”?
gloss: Which director made 'E.T.' and 'Jurassic Park'? — Steven Spielberg.

text: Tulisan Jawi menambah beberapa huruf baharu pada abjad Arab untuk bunyi Melayu yang tiada dalam bahasa Arab. Bunyi manakah TIDAK memerlukan huruf tambahan itu?
gloss: Jawi added letters to the Arabic alphabet for Malay sounds Arabic lacks. Which sound needs no added letter? — 'b': Arabic has ب. Arabic has no c, ng or p, so Jawi added چ, ڠ and ڤ.

text: Nama Kuala Lumpur berasal daripada pertemuan dua sungai yang berlumpur, tempat Masjid Jamek berdiri kini. Sungai Gombak bertemu sungai apa?
gloss: Kuala Lumpur, 'muddy confluence', is where two rivers meet at today's Masjid Jamek. The Gombak meets which river? — The Klang.

text: Anda nampak kilat memancar, dan bunyi guruhnya sampai tiga saat kemudian. Lebih kurang berapa jauhkah kilat itu dari anda?
gloss: You see lightning and hear the thunder 3 seconds later. How far away is it? — About 1 km: sound travels about 340 m per second, light arrives almost instantly.

text: Menara Berkembar Petronas, yang reka bentuknya diilhamkan oleh corak geometri Islam, direka oleh arkitek mana?
gloss: The Petronas Twin Towers, inspired by Islamic geometric patterns, were designed by which architect? — César Pelli (Argentine-American).

text: Garisan Khatulistiwa merentasi tiga daripada empat negara ini. Negara manakah yang tidak dilaluinya?
gloss: The equator crosses three of these four countries. Which one does it miss? — Malaysia: its southernmost point is about 1° north. The equator crosses Sumatra, Borneo's Indonesian part, Kenya and Brazil.

text: Acara maraton memperingati legenda seorang utusan Yunani yang berlari dari Marathon untuk menyampaikan berita penting. Ke kota manakah dia berlari?
gloss: The marathon commemorates the legend of a Greek messenger who ran from Marathon with important news. To which city? — Athens.

text: Melodi lagu kebangsaan “Negaraku” diambil daripada lagu rasmi sebuah negeri. Negeri manakah itu?
gloss: The melody of the national anthem 'Negaraku' was taken from which state's anthem? — Perak ('Allah Lanjutkan Usia Sultan').

text: Kapten Ahab, yang sanggup mengorbankan segalanya untuk memburu seekor paus putih, ialah watak ciptaan pengarang mana?
gloss: Captain Ahab, who sacrifices everything to hunt a white whale, was created by which writer? — Herman Melville (Moby-Dick).

text: Tarian zapin dibawa ke Alam Melayu oleh pedagang dan pendakwah yang datang dari negeri mana?
gloss: The zapin dance was brought to the Malay world by traders and preachers from where? — Yemen (Hadhramaut).

text: Berapakah bilangan nombor perdana antara 1 hingga 20?
gloss: How many primes are there from 1 to 20? — 8: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19. 9 traps those who count 1, which is not prime.

text: Perkataan “kamus” dipinjam daripada bahasa Arab. Apakah maksud asal perkataan itu sebelum ia digunakan untuk buku rujukan kata?
gloss: 'Kamus' (dictionary) comes from Arabic. What did it originally mean? — Ocean: Arabic qāmūs, from the title of al-Fīrūzābādī's dictionary 'al-Qāmūs al-Muḥīṭ' (the surrounding ocean).

text: Laksamana Cheng Ho, yang armadanya singgah di Melaka beberapa kali, ialah seorang Muslim. Dari wilayah China manakah dia berasal?
gloss: Admiral Zheng He, whose fleets called at Malacca, was a Muslim. Which Chinese province was he from? — Yunnan (born in Kunyang). Fujian (Changle) was where his fleets waited for the monsoon; Xinjiang tempts as a Muslim region.

text: Darah haiwan manakah berwarna biru kerana mengandungi tembaga, bukan besi?
gloss: Whose blood is blue because it carries copper, not iron? — The horseshoe crab (belangkas): its blood uses haemocyanin. Sharks, turtles and crocodiles have red, iron-based blood.

text: Siri lukisan “Pago-Pago”, yang mengolah bentuk tumbuhan dan seni bina Asia Tenggara, adalah karya pelukis mana?
gloss: The 'Pago-Pago' series, reworking South-East Asian plant forms and architecture, is by which painter? — Latiff Mohidin (1960s). The others are fellow Malaysian painters.

text: Bumi tidak bulat sempurna; ia sedikit membonjol di Khatulistiwa. Puncak manakah titik permukaan Bumi yang paling jauh dari pusatnya?
gloss: The Earth bulges at the equator. Which summit is farthest from the Earth's centre? — Chimborazo in Ecuador: almost on the equator and over 6,200 m high. Everest is higher above sea level but far from the bulge; Kinabalu tempts as an equatorial peak but is only about 4,100 m.

text: Dalam ensembel nobat diraja, alat tiup yang berbentuk trompet panjang dikenali sebagai apa?
gloss: In the royal nobat ensemble, what is the long trumpet-shaped wind instrument called? — The nafiri. The serunai is also in the nobat but is a reed (oboe-like) instrument.

text: Wasabi tulen yang dihidangkan bersama sushi diparut daripada batang sejenis tumbuhan. Tumbuhan itu sekeluarga dengan apa?
gloss: Real wasabi is grated from a plant stem. That plant is in the same family as what? — Cabbage: wasabi belongs to the Brassicaceae, like mustard and horseradish. Ginger tempts because both are grated pungent roots.

text: Bahasa pengaturcaraan Python dinamakan sempena apa?
gloss: What is the Python programming language named after? — The comedy group Monty Python; Guido van Rossum was a fan. The snake and the Greek monster Python are the traps.

text: Jisim seorang angkasawan di Bumi ialah 60 kg. Graviti di Bulan hanya kira-kira satu per enam graviti Bumi. Berapakah jisimnya di Bulan?
gloss: An astronaut's mass on Earth is 60 kg; the Moon's gravity is about a sixth of Earth's. What is the mass on the Moon? — Still 60 kg: mass doesn't depend on gravity, only weight does. 10 kg is the trap.

text: Bulan Ramadan datang lebih awal sedikit setiap tahun Masihi. Lebih kurang berapa tahun diperlukan sebelum ia kembali jatuh pada tarikh Masihi yang sama?
gloss: Ramadan comes a little earlier each Gregorian year. About how many years until it returns to the same Gregorian date? — About 33: the lunar Hijri year is about 11 days shorter, and 365 ÷ 11 ≈ 33. 11 is the number trap; 19 is the Metonic cycle.
